disclosed_matters.topic: Mis-issuance using CNAME CSR Hash 2 method of domain control validation
disclosed_matters.summary: Sectigo used an underscore before the domain name which was not necessary; no revocation required.
Sectigo revoked certificates outside the expected timing.
Sectigo issued one certificate with an invalid DNS name, but the certificate was revoked the same day.
